reason: The README describes a GUI plugin for creating WSL workspaces where agent bash commands and file operations run against a local Linux distribution, making files and terminal integration its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中添加 WSL 工作区，并在选定的本地 Linux 发行版中执行命令及读写文件。
summaries.en: Adds WSL workspaces to the DeepSeek Harness web interface so commands and file operations can run in a selected local Linux distribution.

capabilities: Adds WSL workspaces through the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
Executes bash commands inside a selected local WSL distribution
Reads, writes, and edits WSL files through the WSL share
Provides access to Windows files through /mnt paths
